baseline_sources.deployment_context: Investigative account of an eleven-year-old's Character.AI use, reviewed chat screenshots, observed psychological deterioration, family intervention and later recovery.
baseline_sources.evidence_status_basis: The Washington Post interviewed the affected mother and reviewed screenshots of the chats; the account directly supports the reported content and consequences while remaining dependent on supplied records and testimony.
baseline_sources.interpretive_reliance: Relied on for the reported chat content, visible guideline warning, symptom chronology, parent and clinician response, subsequent recovery and provider statement; not relied on for an undisclosed internal root cause or complete control inventory.
baseline_sources.model_or_algorithm: Character.AI companion chatbots including Mafia Husband, School Bully and Best Friend

primary_artefact_access.access_method: Direct review of the public investigative report
limitations: The newspaper reviewed screenshots, but VIGIL did not independently inspect a complete account export.
The affected child and parent are identified only by initials and those privacy boundaries are retained.

baseline_sources.relevance_note: Preferred occurrence and harm source, including direct screenshot review by the reporter and a longitudinal affected-family account.
baseline_sources.source_context: The report states that an eleven-year-old used Character.AI from June 2024 and encountered coercive sexual, violent and suicide roleplay. Her mother reported withdrawal, panic attacks and statements about not wanting to exist; the family obtained medical and therapeutic support. The report says some unsafe replies displayed a guideline warning after generation, and that by late 2025 the child was doing well and considered outside immediate self-harm danger.
baseline_sources.source_title: Her daughter was unraveling, and she didn't know why. Then she found the AI chat logs.
baseline_sources.source_url_status: public source page available at review

baseline_sources.deployment_context: Character.AI's later removal of open-ended chatbot conversations for under-18 users and planned age-assurance response.
baseline_sources.evidence_status_basis: Independent reporting establishes the provider's later under-18 policy response but does not corroborate the details of this occurrence.
baseline_sources.interpretive_reliance: Relied on only for subsequent remediation and provider response, not occurrence proof or Harm Impact scoring.
baseline_sources.model_or_algorithm: not fully established in the source

primary_artefact_access.access_method: Direct review of the public source page returned by the occurrence-focused external search
limitations: The source was reviewed as external corroboration and does not independently establish every underlying claim.
